title: Cross-wave wording-change registry (v1)
description: JSON Schema for src/config/_wording_changes.yml. The registry documents (variable x wave-pair) cells where between-wave drift is EXPECTED — either because the question wording, response scale, or coding scheme changed (a measurement artifact that should mute the Layer 5 drift alert) OR because a real political event drove the shift (kept visible as signal, never muted). Each entry must cite a specific source so reviewers can re-derive the classification, and `category` distinguishes mute-eligible measurement artifacts from non-mute real-change documentation. The headline guarantee is additionalProperties: false at every object level so typos like `wording_chnage:` or `suppres_until:` fail loud.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be the integer 1 for this revision.

description.description: Free-text paragraph describing the registry's scope and conventions.

last_reviewed.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last human review of the registry as a whole. Per-entry review dates live on each entry.

entries.description: List of registered (variable x wave-pair) drift annotations. The Layer 5 audit consults this list to decide whether a TVD/KS-D exceedance should mute (mute-eligible categories below `suppress_until`) or always fire (real_political_change, never muted).

surveySlug.description: Survey slug matching the keys used by `list_survey_specs()` and the directory names under `src/config/<survey>/`. Snake-case-or-hyphen lowercase.

snakeCaseId.description: Snake-case identifier for this registry entry. Convention: <variable>__<wave_from>_<wave_to> (double underscore separating variable from wave-pair).

waveKey.description: Wave identifier. Surveys use heterogeneous conventions (w1, y1995, r5, w2003, w2025).

categoryEnum.description: Type of cross-wave change documented by this entry. wording_change | coding_change | scale_change | category_recode are MEASUREMENT artifacts and mute drift alerts (subject to suppress_until). real_political_change is documented for context but does NOT mute — drift here is real signal.

variable.description: Snake-case harmonized variable id (matches an `id:` declared in some harmonization YAML).

wave_pair.description: Two wave keys [from, to] in chronological order. Both must match a wave that exists in the harmonized output for this survey.

reason.description: 20-1000 character substantive explanation of what changed and why drift is expected. NOT tautological. Must cite a specific source (codebook page, scale-direction note, project memory, dated political event).

source.description: Human-readable source citation — e.g. 'ABS Wave 3 codebook p.45', 'docs/surveys/abs.md scale-direction notes', 'CLAUDE.md root', 'Park impeachment 2017-03-10 Constitutional Court ruling'.

suppress_until.description: TVD/KS-D threshold above which the registry entry STOPS muting and the drift alert fires anyway (because the change wasn't supposed to invert the entire distribution). Range [0, 1]. Defaults to 1.0 (always mute) if omitted. Has no effect for category=real_political_change because that category never mutes.

last_reviewed.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last human review of this entry's classification.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes — caveats, related entries, follow-up TODOs.
